title: Punch-Item Retainage at Window Contract Payoff
content:
# Punch-Item Retainage at Window Contract Payoff

Window Replacement Contracts — retainage held at payoff against open punch items on the contract's Installation Jobs record.

**Rule.** The punch retainage is held from the job charges by the number of punch items logged on the installation job and not yet resolved: with three or more open items, all of the job's net charges are held; with one or two open items, the per-item retainage of $150 is held for each open item; with none, nothing is held.

The installation job is the contract's job that is not cancelled; a contract with no such job has no punch items. Open items are the punch items logged on the job less those recorded as resolved.

| Open punch items | Retainage held |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing |
| 1 | $150 |
| 2 | $300 ($150 for each) |
| 3 or more | All of the installation job's net charges |

## Hypothetical cases (job net charges $900)

- Four items logged, two resolved: 2 open, $300 held.
- Five items logged, one resolved: 4 open, the whole $900 held.
